description: in evaluation must use slot-specific parents when principal / resource share the same (type, id). The C subset has independent per-slot parent arrays (no entity store), so the caller is allowed to register different parents to the same identity. Cedar's spec model requires a single entity per UID; the FFI oracle rejects these scenarios at entity-store construction time. All cases are marked c_limit and skipped in oracle comparison.

tests.name: scope_resource_in_uses_resource_parents
tests.description: resource scope must consult resource_parents even though principal shares the same identity

tests.name: scope_resource_in_ignores_principal_parents
tests.description: principal_parents must not satisfy a resource-scope in when identity matches

tests.name: scope_principal_in_uses_principal_parents
tests.description: principal scope must consult principal_parents even though resource shares the same identity

tests.name: scope_principal_in_ignores_resource_parents
tests.description: resource_parents must not satisfy a principal-scope in when identity matches

tests.name: when_resource_in_uses_resource_parents
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { resource in Group::"readers" };

tests.name: when_resource_in_ignores_principal_parents
tests.description: when-clause `resource in <group>` must not be satisfied by principal_parents
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { resource in Group::"readers" };

tests.name: when_principal_in_uses_principal_parents
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { principal in Group::"writers" };

tests.name: when_principal_in_ignores_resource_parents
tests.description: when-clause `principal in <group>` must not be satisfied by resource_parents
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { principal in Group::"writers" };
